sessions.phase_label: Cover corrections, platform planning, and first export review
Rendering correction, Amazon upload troubleshooting, and D2D specification clarification
D2D cover production and final file delivery

requirements.title: Blurb Replacement and Reflow
requirements.definition: Replace the existing final blurb paragraph with the client's shortened text and reflow it so the blurb does not overlap the barcode.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers only blurb content placement and reflow; title styling, text-rendering integrity, platform dimensions, and delivered file formats are independently testable Requirements.

requirements.title: Title Font Consistency
requirements.definition: Make the title typography on the spine and back cover match the bold gold-gradient title typography used on the front cover.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers visual consistency of the title itself; correct rendering of other text during export is separate because it has its own failure and fix trajectory.

requirements.title: Cover Text Rendering Integrity
requirements.definition: Export the cover so all text, including the front-cover tagline, renders as the intended wording without corruption or dependence on unavailable fonts.
requirements.boundary_note: The garbled tagline and font-embedding or outlining constraint form an independently testable export-rendering behavior, separate from the intended visual font style and PDF upload size.

requirements.title: Amazon Cover Specification
requirements.definition: Provide an Amazon-specific paperback cover laid out for the Amazon print configuration, including the confirmed 300-page count and 0.75-inch spine.
requirements.boundary_note: The Amazon layout remains separate from the D2D layout because the platforms use different page counts and spine dimensions and their work proceeds independently.

requirements.title: Draft2Digital Cover Specification
requirements.definition: Provide a distinct Draft2Digital paperback cover using the D2D print template and its ultimately confirmed page-count and spine-width specifications.
requirements.boundary_note: This Requirement owns the independently deferred and resumed D2D layout, including its 302-page and spine-width decisions; Ingram is contextual to D2D distribution rather than a third cover variant.

requirements.title: Amazon PDF Upload Compatibility
requirements.definition: Provide an Amazon cover PDF that can be processed and uploaded successfully, with an optimized lower-size export available without reducing print quality.
requirements.boundary_note: Upload processing and file-size optimization can fail or be corrected independently of cover dimensions and text appearance, so they are not attributes of the Amazon layout Requirement.

requirements.title: Final Cover Deliverable Package
requirements.definition: Deliver the completed cover assets in layered PSD, PDF, and JPG formats, with the Amazon and D2D PDF variants distinguishable and included in the final delivery.
requirements.boundary_note: Required formats, layered source delivery, and platform identification are tightly coupled packaging attributes; they do not own the visual corrections or platform-specific layout rules.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001]
I have a small, quick task and wanted to check whether you’re available.

• My paperback cover requires 2 minor fixes: removing a few words from my blurb and making the title font consistent across the front/spine/back. This is not a redesign; the files are otherwise final.
• Required outputs: .psd (layered), .pdf, .jpg
• Turnaround needed within 24 hours
• Can you take this on?

My budget is $30.

[FREELANCER_NAME_003],
[CLIENT_NAME_001]

value_updates.blurb_edit: remove a few words from the existing blurb

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001], thank you for replying so quickly.

Two minor corrections are required, not a redesign.
Blurb replacement: I trimmed the last paragraph, which currently overlaps the barcode, so the new text only needs to be inserted and reflowed.
Title font mismatch: the front cover has a bold gold-gradient font, while the spine/back use a simpler one; they all need to match the front.
I'll provide the images, templates, and the .psd.
I need the .psd (layered), .pdf, and .jpg returned within 24 hours — is that workable?

value_updates.blurb_edit: replace the existing last paragraph with the client's trimmed text and reflow it so it does not overlap the barcode

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001],

I’ll try posting on D2D's social media; perhaps that will prompt a quicker reply.

However, I found an issue with your cover.

• The blurb correction and title font both look good and were fixed properly.
• There is one issue: the tagline at the top of the front cover ("A CHINESE HOLIDAY MURDER MYSTERY") appears as garbled, corrupted text rather than the actual wording.
• It seems likely to be a font-substitution or encoding problem, so please verify which font that text box uses.
• During the new export, please ensure the fonts are embedded or outlined/converted to curves so the text renders correctly everywhere without relying on font availability.
• Please correct this and re-send the .pdf first.

Thx
C-

execution.observed_behavior: The client visually verified that the blurb correction looked good and had been fixed properly.
